senses.gloss: (const. אִיתְכַּל) m. = h. אֶשְׁכֹּל (q. v.) bunch of grapes.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Numbers 13:24">Targ. Num. XIII, 24</cite>; a. e.—Pl. <he>אִיתְכָּלִין</he>, <he>אַתְכָּ׳</he>, <he>אִיתְכָּלַיָּיא</he>.
Targ. I Sam. XXV, 18; a. e.—Trnsf. scholars, opp. עילייא (leaves), the untutored.

<cite ref="Chullin 92a:16">Ḥull. 92ᵃ</cite> <he>ליבעי רחמי וכ׳</he> let the grapes pray for the leaves (the scholars for the untutored); for but for the leaves, the grapes could not exist. V. <cite ref="A03307"><he>אֶשְׁכֹּל</he></cite>.
